title: AAV-delivered TNF-α inhibitors for the treatment of non-infectious uveitis.
snippet: Non-infectious uveitis (NIU) is a vision-threatening inflammatory disease of the eye, which can require long-term systemic immunosuppression associated with significant side effects.
